description: NRG Text-to-SQL Accuracy Evaluation Dataset — based on Dhairya's 17-query audit

queries.question: Which curriculum is most innovation-intensive according to credits-based analysis?
queries.notes: Simple SUM/GROUP BY with ORDER BY — Q1

queries.question: What is the PhD to undergraduate researcher ratio for IIT Bombay?
queries.notes: Computed ratio instead of showing per-level counts — Q2

queries.question: Which funding agencies showed a grant drop of more than 50% year-over-year?
queries.notes: CTE pattern used but aggregation level was wrong — partial success

queries.question: What are the top 5 funding agencies by total amount received?
queries.notes: ORDER BY without aggregation — Q4 failed completely

queries.question: What percentage of IIT Madras innovations are at Lab Validation stage?
queries.notes: Calculated correctly but question interpretation off — Q5

queries.question: How many TRL-9 Market Ready innovations does IIT Madras have?
queries.notes: String mismatch: TRL 9 vs Level 9 — Q6 failed completely

queries.question: What is the cost of innovation (grant per patent granted) by institute?
queries.notes: JOIN on applicants vs institute — Q7 wrong join column

queries.question: How many PG courses were added at IIT Madras in the last 3 years?
queries.notes: Basic filter + IN clause — Q8 correct

queries.question: Which institution has the most PhD courses?
queries.notes: Simple COUNT/GROUP BY with LIMIT — Q9 correct

queries.question: How does IIT Madras PhD enrollment compare to their undergraduate numbers?
queries.notes: Switched to student_strength table instead of courses — Q10 wrong domain

queries.question: What is the year-over-year growth rate for PG courses at IIT Madras?
queries.notes: Window function used but wrong metric — partial success

queries.question: Show the strategy shift where UG courses stopped but PhD courses spiked
queries.notes: Queried phd_students instead of courses — Q12 wrong table

queries.question: What is the correlation between number of courses and startup count by institute?
queries.notes: Basic aggregation + JOIN (with over-join) — Q13 worked

queries.question: Which courses have high capital expenditure but low innovation output?
queries.notes: HAVING narrowed to zero courses only — Q14 wrong HAVING

queries.question: Which institutes are rising stars (funding growth above average)?
queries.notes: Complete failure — multi-step reasoning needed — Q15 error

queries.question: Which institutes have high grants but low expenditure utilization?
queries.notes: Query truncated, missing HAVING — Q16 incomplete

queries.question: Show the pipeline progression across TRL stages over time
queries.notes: Simple GROUP BY but lost time dimension — Q17 worked
